subject: Egypt
note: Cited to a pinned Wikipedia revision (trusted_secondary): Egypt. The pictures are NASA VIIRS Black Marble (annual) for 2012 and 2016 (GIBS offers those two). Light at night is not a measure of population; the script states the population figures from the page and says what the picture shows, nothing about causes beyond the page's.

claims.text: At 1,001,450 square kilometres, Egypt is the world's 29th largest country.
98% of Egyptians live on 3% of the territory.
Population centres are concentrated along the narrow Nile Valley and Delta.
The Nile provides approximately 90% of Egypt's total water resources.
NASA VIIRS Black Marble night-lights pictures of Egypt, 2012 and 2016 (NASA GIBS).
